method: Per-parcel median NISAR GCOV change (dB). Flag when the HH median (HH_*) or the HH or HV median moves >= T dB, any direction, down or up. Suspected area = (typhoon-interval flagged share - control-interval flagged share) x farmland area. No trained model.
screening_rule: >= 3 valid 20 m pixels and >= 80% of the parcel covered, both intervals, one frame

interval_median_shift_db.note: typhoon minus control median change on county land; version offset plus any county-wide change, not removed

farmland_source: 國土利用現況調查 雲林縣 農作使用 (水田/旱田/果園)
